current_point.claim: 提出基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络优化训练框架DSGNN，采用领导-工作者模式，领导节点负责图划分与模型同步更新，工作节点基于图摘要技术进行小批量训练，并通过注意力层返回结果。
current_point.claim_en: Propose a distributed graph neural network optimization training framework DSGNN based on graph summarization, adopting a leader-worker mode where the leader node handles graph partitioning and synchronous model updates, and worker nodes perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization and return results via an attention layer.
technical_features: 采用领导-工作者工作模式
领导节点利用基于边分割的图流划分算法对原图进行划分并分配子图
工作节点执行基于图摘要技术的小批量训练
训练结果通过注意力层返回给领导节点
领导节点汇总结果并计算梯度，同步更新所有计算节点上的模型
technical_features_en: Leader node partitions the original graph using an edge-segmentation-based graph stream partitioning algorithm and assigns subgraphs
Worker nodes perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization
Training results are returned to the leader node through an attention layer
Leader node aggregates results, computes gradients, and synchronously updates models on all computing nodes
